cards.title: Major error spike at hour 14
cards.detail: Hour 14 experienced 1,460 errors out of 9,225 requests (15.83% error rate), representing 67.3% of the total 2,169 errors observed during the week.

cards.title: Near-total outage in request volume at hour 3
cards.detail: Request traffic dropped to just 2 requests during hour 3, compared to a steady baseline of 8,899 requests per hour across nearly all other hours.

cards.title: Caller-01 drives majority of volume and spend
cards.detail: Caller caller-01 generated 105,832 requests and $1,643.86 in spend, accounting for 51.6% of overall requests and 49.0% of total API costs.

cards.title: Caller-07 exhibits disproportionately high cost per request
cards.detail: Caller caller-07 spent $174.12 across 1,180 requests, averaging $0.1476 per request compared to the system-wide average of $0.0164 per request.

cards.title: Bimodal cache performance across caller base
cards.detail: Ten callers recorded cache hit rates below 9% (as low as 3.7% for caller-21), whereas twelve other callers achieved hit rates between 82.3% and 88.8%.

cards.title: Model-epsilon failing all requests
cards.detail: Model model-epsilon recorded a 100% error rate across all 40 requests received during the window, generating $0 in successful spend.
